To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the implementation of an ethics model will assist in the development of an ethical organisation, especially if the model is implemented by the organisation itself.

the organisations in the Eastern Cape motor industry cluster do not implement specific ethical interventions, but that the majority of organisations acknowledge the importance of ethics and ethical behaviour.

the organisations in ECMIF are not implementing specific ethics interventions, but do acknowledge the importance of ethics and ethical behaviour within their organisations, with a view to creating an ethical organisation, especially with a view to the financial position of the organisation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a business ethics intervention model for organisations.
the impact of ethics in organisations and how such ethics can be implemented in an organisation to achieve a positive outcome for the organisation.
the impact of business and organisational ethics in the Eastern cape motor industry cluster and the different perceptions of the same.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
ethics is a very important aspect of any organisation and that it should be implemented in all organisations, irrespective of size.
there is a need for a business ethics model to be developed in ECMIC.
ethics interventions are not being implemented to the degree that is necessary in order to create an ethical organisation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ethics is not just a nice to have, but a must for organisations to survive.

the implementation of an ethics intervention model would create a platform to establish a culture of ethical behaviour in organisations and, in so doing, create a competitive advantage for the organisations.
the implementation of an ethics model in the motor industry would create a platform from where an ethical organisation could be established.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the establishment of an ethical organisation is a continuous and never ending task and, as such must be embedded in all organisational processes.
there is a need for a code of ethics in organisations, and that such codes should be implemented in order to ensure that ethical behaviour is practised in organisations.
organisations should strive towards establishing an ethical organisation, which would have long-term benefits for the organisation.
